gist: Speech matches identity and charm comes easily, but ease needs one real detail to keep it from coasting.

en.body: You sound like yourself today, and people can tell. Make the pitch, the toast, the introduction; just don't coast on charm alone.
en.notification: Ease is a gift. Add one real detail.

tr.body: Bugün tam kendin gibi konuşuyorsun ve herkes fark ediyor. Teklifi, kadehi, tanışmayı yap; yalnızca cazibene yaslanma.
tr.notification: Kolaylık hediye. Bir gerçek ayrıntı ekle.

gist: Feelings translate into words cheaply, and sharing how things have been lands warmer than expected.

en.body: Putting a feeling into words doesn't cost much today. Tell someone how the week has been; it'll land warmer than you rehearsed.
en.notification: Say it plainly. They'll hear the rest.

tr.body: Bir duyguyu kelimelere dökmek bugün pahalıya gelmiyor. Haftanın nasıl geçtiğini birine anlat; prova ettiğinden sıcak iner.

gist: Thinking falls into order easily, which suits a task that has only seemed complicated.

en.body: Thoughts line up in the right order without a fight. Use it on something you've been avoiding by calling it complicated.
en.notification: It's simpler than the story you've told yourself.

tr.body: Düşünceler kavga etmeden doğru sıraya diziliyor. Karmaşık diyerek kaçındığın bir işe bunu kullan.

gist: Conversation itself becomes the affection, and staying in a good exchange is the point.

en.body: Conversation is the flirt today, whether or not you mean it that way. Linger on a good exchange instead of wrapping it up early.
en.notification: Stay in the good talk a little longer.

tr.body: Sohbetin kendisi flört bugün, öyle kastetsen de kastetmesen de. İyi giden bir konuşmayı erken bitirmek yerine uzat.

gist: Words and drive pull in the same direction, so pitching and starting is easy and follow-through is the real test.

en.body: Your words and your drive are on the same team. Pitch the idea, send the request, start the thing; following through is the only hard part.
en.notification: Say it, then do the first part.

tr.body: Sözlerin ile hareket gücün aynı takımda. Fikri sun, isteği gönder, işe başla; takip etmek tek zor kısım.

gist: A good idea easily finds a good listener, and sharing an unfinished plan draws useful generosity.

en.body: A good idea finds a good listener without much effort. Share the plan you've half-built; feedback will be generous and useful.

tr.body: İyi bir fikir, pek uğraşmadan iyi bir dinleyici buluyor. Yarım kurduğun planı paylaş; geri bildirim cömert ve işe yarar olacak.

gist: Care and clarity arrive together, so finishing a dull task is easy and over-polishing is the main risk.

en.body: Careful and clear thinking show up together. Finish the paperwork or the dull email while it's easy, and resist polishing it twice.
en.notification: Done is also a form of rigor.

tr.body: Dikkatli ve net düşünce birlikte geliyor. Evrakı ya da sıkıcı e-postayı kolayken bitir, iki kez parlatma.

gist: An unusual idea settles in without resistance, and saying it aloud keeps it from being tamed.

en.body: An original idea slides into place with no resistance. Say it out loud to someone before your inner editor makes it ordinary.

tr.body: Özgün bir fikir hiç direnmeden yerine oturuyor. İç editörün onu sıradanlaştırmadan birine yüksek sesle söyle.

gist: Imagination and language cooperate, which makes starting a long-imagined piece of writing easy.

en.body: Imagination and language cooperate beautifully today. Write the first paragraph of the thing you keep daydreaming about.

tr.body: Hayal gücü ile dil bugün güzel iş birliği yapıyor. Hep hayalini kurduğun şeyin ilk paragrafını yaz.

gist: Perception cuts through confusion without drama, and one calm sentence naming the real issue shortens the talk.

en.body: You see through a muddle quickly and without drama. Name the real issue in one calm sentence; the talk that follows is shorter than you fear.
en.notification: Calm precision cuts deeper than volume.

tr.body: Karışıklığı hızla ve dramasız çözüyorsun. Asıl meseleyi sakin tek cümleyle söyle; ardından gelen konuşma korktuğundan kısa sürer.
tr.notification: Sakin kesinlik, ses yüksekliğinden derin keser.
